# nemau project

Select and inspect the target project.

The project is resolved in this order, most explicit first:

```
--project              for a single command
NEMAU_PROJECT_ID       for a shell or a CI job
nemau project use      saved in ~/.config/nemau/config.json
(nothing)              the project the credential itself carries
```

Nothing is stored on the platform: two shells can target two projects with the
same access key. A service account pinned to a project cannot leave it: the
API answers 403.

## Usage

```
nemau project [command]
```

Aliases: `projects`, `p`

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [current](nemau_project_current.md) | Show the target project and where that choice comes from |
| [list](nemau_project_list.md) | List the organization's projects |
| [unset](nemau_project_unset.md) | Forget the saved project |
| [use](nemau_project_use.md) | Save the default target project |

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
